reference.source: lengthM keeps the existing 107.5 m gameplay hit box; English Wikipedia 'Shiratsuyu-class destroyer' (read 2026-10-11) identifies 107.5 m as waterline length and gives 109.6 m overall, 9.9 m beam, 3.5 m draught and 34 kn original speed (maxSpeedMps converted with 1 kn = 0.514444 m/s). Japanese Monograph 145, an official postwar translation, records six Shiratsuyu-class ships in the 1931 construction program (primary class confirmation, checked 2026-09-26). deckHeightM and turnRateRadPerS (3 deg/s, Fletcher's existing gameplay figure) are ESTIMATES. hullHp equals the Fletcher's 160 as a gameplay choice. ARMAMENT (read 2026-10-08 and rechecked 2026-10-11): the class's 2x2 + 1x1 Type 3 127 mm and wartime removal of the single X mount for a triple 25 mm, with 13 to 21 x 25 mm in twin and triple mounts plus 4 x 13 mm (English Wikipedia); Samidare's X mount 'probably removed/replaced by triple 25mm mount' at the 13-19 December 1943 Yokosuka refit (CombinedFleet TROM). Both surviving twin mounts are kept non-AA (aa null) as the existing gameplay choice. Their positions and the 12 drawn 25 mm barrels are FITTED existing locators, now standing on the original Blender hull traced from Wikimedia Commons 'Fig of IJN DD Samidare in 1944.gif' (July 1944 side and plan drawing, read 2026-10-11); every non-null kit trains and elevates.
